x: Jim Vivian had the galling experience of beating all British contenders, underlining the fact that he is the best Junior 'dash' specialist in the country, yet losing the AAA title to South African, Paul Nash.
FRONT COVER: (Photo by Ed Lacey) Jim Vivian (38) matches world-record holder Paul Nash stride for stride in his heat of the A.A.A. 100 yds at White City.

Vivian was drawn in the first heat with world champion, Paul Nash (S.A.), and finished a good second in 10.1 - same time as Nash. John Mitchell had to wait until Heat 6 for his stint knowing that Piggot and Reynolds were dangerous opposition but knowing little of the South African T.
